# What check API epoch 3 promises — the check-authoring surface of
# architecture.md §11 as it stood when API_VERSION became 3 (ADR-0051).
#
# Epoch 3 opened on a **behavior**, not a name. `Check.run()` became
# `Check.measure()` and `Check.grade()` (ADR-0086): a check reads the world in one
# half and says what it read means in the other, so that a grading can be run
# again over an old record when the process that took it is gone. `Measurement`
# joined the surface as the one place an object and its reading live, `clip`
# joined it as the one way free text is fitted into a record, and `CheckResult`
# lost its `subject` and `record` fields to the measurement.
#
# The fields are not names on this list, so nothing was removed from it — which is
# exactly why the epoch had to move on the behavior instead. A type built for v2
# cannot be adapted at runtime: it would still decide a code from a world it
# re-reads inside the grading, which is the failure the split exists to make
# impossible. So it refuses at import, naming both numbers.
#
# A plugin built for v3 imports these names. tests/test_public_surface.py requires
# the block in §11 to still contain every line here, so a name cannot leave the
# surface without API_VERSION moving — the one check a same-commit rename of both
# the code and the doc cannot quietly satisfy.
#
# This file is APPEND-ONLY within an epoch: adding a name to the surface may add a
# line, removing one is a new epoch and a new file (check_api_v4.txt). Never edit a
# line out of it; a released plugin is still importing that name.
#
# One "<module> <name>" per line.
little_sister.checks API_VERSION
little_sister.checks CHECKS_ASPECT
little_sister.checks CHECK_TYPES
little_sister.checks Check
